$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, you idiot! A guy like you deserves to get hurt a little!」

166:t_109:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! This day has finally come!」

166:t_109:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$... Answer me one thing.」

166:t_109:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「You said you would stop me if I ever did something reckless. Is now that time?」

166:t_109:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Unable to answer, are you...? I'm not so cheap that a man like that could take me down.」

166:t_109:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up! You're going to be my stepping stone!」

166:t_109:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass you and prove that I'm a better man than you are!」

166:t_110:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ$$! Your fighting spirit is different from last time...!」

166:t_110:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I left persuading you to $$クェス$$ and the Colonel! I'm going to teach you how pointless it is to fight alone!」

166:t_110:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't be ridiculous! Say that kind of thing after you've beaten me!」

166:t_111:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$... You are a Super $$コーディネイター$$. Should you really be in a place like this?」

166:t_111:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have my share of connections in $$プラント$$, you see. That is why I also know the truth about $$コーディネイター$$s.」

166:t_111:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「The truth about $$コーディネイター$$s...!?」

166:t_111:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ignorance truly is bliss. But at times, it becomes a sin.」

166:t_111:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You, who do not fulfill your own mission, will one day receive a fitting punishment.」
